jyutping: bei2 hang4 jan4 jung6 ge3 N

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to describe something intended for pedestrians.

examples.english: This path is intended for pedestrian use, and bicycles are not allowed in here.
examples.traditional: 呢條路係畀行人用嘅，唔准單車入嚟。
